avis.titre: best reapply face sunscreen for work
avis.texte: I love this for reapplication before I get in the car at work. It acts more like a korean sunscreen stick and is not waterproof. It says its hydrating in subscription. While I don't agree that its hydrating it doesn't dry out my skin either. I have very dry skin and sometimes I use heavy moisturizers. sometimes there is pilling with them but only if I dont let the moisturizer set down. I also have very sensitive skin and this is odorless and has never given me a rash or acne. which is super rare with american sunscreens. would recommend!
